race.description: The Sporting Globe After The Last Mcc Series Ht 8 Hcp (Bm78)
race.comment: Good little race with an eye to the final on Oaks Day. Siding with BEL MEZYAAN (11) who resumes. He was racing in good form last time in, the highlight a narrow defeat in the Listed Bendigo Guineas behind Gold Coast Belle. Anything like that form will go close here. Wary of COL KLINK (16) who won dominantly first up over 1100m here then worked home well to this trip at Horsham in a similar race. Turns around quickly and should be better for the run with Lane on a positive. SILVER BULLET (15) wasn't beaten all that far fresh at Ballarat and should be fitter to this trip. He can try to slot in behind the pace and go close. SHAALUTE (10) is very consistent and should be right there again. ROSA AOTEAROA (6) can improve second up to 1400m and should give a sight.
